description: Source code for project management module in OpenERP/Odoo, defining classes and methods for projects, tasks, task types, work logs, and configuration.

classes.name: project
classes.description: Represents a project with attributes like name, category, manager, tasks, and state; includes methods for status changes, copying, and validation.

classes.name: project_task_type
classes.description: Defines types of tasks within projects, with name and description.

classes.name: task
classes.description: Represents individual tasks with details like hours, status, dependencies, and related work logs.

classes.name: project_work
classes.description: Logs work done on tasks, including hours, date, and user.

classes.name: config_compute_remaining
classes.description: Memory wizard for recalculating remaining hours on tasks.
